For each 1≤ p≤ m, you have to find the minimum possible variance of a after exactly p operations are performed, independently for each p.

For simplicity, you only need to output the answers multiplied by n^2. It can be proven that the results are always integers.

Each test contains multiple test cases. The first line of the input contains a single integer t (1≤ t≤ 100) — the number of test cases. The description of test cases follows.

The second line contains n integers a_1,a_2,…, a_n (1≤ a_i≤ 10^5) — the elements of the array a.

It is guaranteed that the sum of n·m over all tests does not exceed 2·10^4.
